name: East Germany

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of black, red and gold, with the state emblem in the centre: a hammer and a pair of compasses inside a wreath of rye wrapped in a black-red-gold ribbon.
flag.symbolism: The hammer stood for the workers, the compasses for the intelligentsia and the rye wreath for the farmers.

hook: East Germany is Germany's black-red-gold with a hammer and compasses in a wreath stamped in the middle; plain stripes mean West Germany or Germany today.
trivia: Until 1959 East and West Germany flew the identical plain black-red-gold tricolour.
At the 1960 and 1964 Olympics the two German states competed as one team under a black-red-gold flag with white Olympic rings.
